id-type-mismatch-on-update.title: Runbook: strip _id from the update body before $set, identity belongs in the filter, never the write; re-hydrate any JSON-round-tripped id back to a real ObjectId first if you need it for the filter

invalid-objectid-format.title: Runbook: validate the incoming id (ObjectId.isValid(value)) before constructing one, and answer a real not-found rather than letting construction throw past your own error handling

duplicate-key-on-unique-index.title: Runbook: catch the real E11000 (err.code === 11000) and answer it as a conflict, never re-check-then-retry the same race; the index is the source of truth, not the application check

negated-delete-filter.title: Runbook: name what to delete, never what to keep; run the filter as a count first and log the number before calling deleteMany, a match count that surprises you was about to be an incident
